title: Laya Browser Grounding: code, test fixtures and raw results for 'Laya-MLX as a Fast Local Decision Engine for Browser Automation'
description: Code, local test fixtures, raw per-decision results and the LaTeX source of a measurement study of Laya-MLX as an element-grounding engine for browser automation on Apple Silicon (iframes, shadow DOM, UI mutations, live sites, baselines, confidence cascades).
